language_hint: Nomi's screens and the crew's replies use this language. Write to the crew in another language and they'll answer in yours.
language_save_failed: Couldn’t save your language. Try again.
mem_empty_body: As you talk with Nomi, it keeps lasting facts — what you like, the people in your life, your routines — so you don't have to repeat yourself. They'll collect here.
mem_forget_body: Nomi won't recall it in future replies. This can't be undone.
mem_forget_failed: Nomi couldn’t forget that. Try again.
mem_forgotten: Forgotten. Nomi won’t bring that up again.
mem_how1: After a reply, Nomi keeps at most one lasting fact from the exchange.
mem_how2: The memories closest to your message are given to Nomi before it answers.
mem_how3: A thumbs-up on a reply strengthens the memories it used; a thumbs-down weakens them.
mem_lede: What Nomi has learned about you while you chat. It recalls these when they're relevant, and you can make it forget anything.
mem_load_failed: Couldn't load your memories just now. Reload the page to try again.
mem_map_caption: Similar memories sit close together. Bigger dots are stronger. Tap one to find it.
mem_map_label: Memory map: similar memories sit closer together
mem_not_used_reply: Not used in a reply yet
money_budget_missing: Pick a category and a monthly limit above zero.

money_expense_missing: Add an amount, what it was for, and a category.
money_lede: What you spent, where it went, and how this month compares. Money keeps an eye on it with you.
